## Decision: INVALID

## Primary result
Not analyzed. The experiment fails the pre-registered SRM validity check, so effect estimates would not be trustworthy.

## Guardrails
Not analyzed. Per the plan, SRM failure invalidates the experiment before any effect or guardrail evaluation.

## Validity checks (SRM, peeking, novelty)
- SRM: **FAILED**. Observed split control 51.27% / treatment 48.73%; chi2 = 18.79, p < 0.0001; SRM check FAILED (p < 0.001): results are not trustworthy [r2].
- Planned split was 50/50 [r1]; observed counts were control 14,901 vs treatment 14,162 [r1].
- Peeking / novelty: not applicable; analysis stopped at SRM.

## Caveats
The SRM threshold is the plan's alpha of p < 0.001 [r1], and this check fails at p < 0.0001 [r2]. This suggests a traffic-allocation or instrumentation problem, not a treatment effect. Do not ship based on this experiment; investigate the mismatch before re-running.

## Exploratory findings
None.
